test_title: PYST 21 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

We are supposed to submit the final report to the department head by the end of the week.

options.text: The final report is supposed to be submitted to the department head by the end of the week by us.
The final report is to be submitted to the department head by the end of the week by us.
The final report was supposed to be submitted to the department head by the end of the week.
We were supposed to submit the final report to the department head by the end of the week.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. The final report is supposed to be submitted to the department head by the end of the week by us.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice: *We are supposed to submit the final report to the department head by the end of the week.*
 
• To convert it into passive voice, the subject ("We") is omitted or placed after "by," and the object ("the final report") becomes the subject of the sentence.
 
• The structure of the passive voice is: **Object + is/are + supposed to be + past participle + by + subject.**
 
• Here, "The final report" becomes the subject, followed by "is supposed to be," and the verb "submitted" is in its past participle form.

Correct transformation: *The final report is supposed to be submitted to the department head by the end of the week by us.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The passive voice is used when the focus is on the action or the object receiving the action, rather than the doer of the action.
 
• The phrase "by us" can be omitted if the doer is not important or obvious from the context.
